notes.title: Switching to ver1.50a
notes.content:
( This text has been translated using a translation tool. )

There is a test release of "Phantasmagoria of Flower View" ver1.50a.
This version included the ability to play over the Internet by specifying an IP address, but it was a test version and was not officially released.
The Steam version of ver1.50a is provided as a beta.

Please check the following article for ver1.50a.
[quote=author]花映塚ver1.50aプレリリース（博麗幻想書譜）
[url=https://kourindou.exblog.jp/1327589/]https://kourindou.exblog.jp/1327589/[/url]
[/quote]

Please note that there are no guarantees when using this version.

[h1] How to switch to ver1.50a [/h1].

[olist]
[*]Please back up the saved data "score.dat" and "th09.cfg" in advance.
[*]Install "Phantasmagoria of Flower View." and open the properties.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42230090/5698ec712cb0e279da885b009f62e48cd3e04ed5.png[/img]
[*]Select "Beta" in the properties and choose ver150a. ver150a will start the Steam update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42230090/661892edf858a1bf288b8b163c4def5a501bc4ec.png[/img]
[*]Start the game and confirm that it is ver150a. If the title does not appear and the game is forcefully terminated after startup, try starting the game again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42230090/cec00735a52156d4b657c73885338048701198e5.png[/img]
[/olist]
